# v1 importer golden fixtures: accounts

GENERATED BY `go run ./internal/migration/golden`. DO NOT HAND EDIT.

Each `accounts-<16 hex>.json` file is one record the real v1 accounts importer produced from one digest-pinned input under `internal/migration/v1/testdata/v1-goldens/`, passed through the harvester's allowlist Redactor. The name is the first 16 hex digits of the sha256 of the file's canonical JSON (sorted keys, 2-space indent, LF, one trailing newline).

## Redaction policy

Each record holds every provider record read back from a scratch registry. Driver, Auth, AccountKind, Tier and KnownModels are kept; Name becomes ACCOUNT-<n>, AuthRef becomes NAME-<n>, and every other field is REDACTED. Changes, journal entries and re-auth prompts pass only through the same NAME-/ACCOUNT- maps; anything they do not map is REDACTED.

## Regenerate

    go run ./internal/migration/golden [--domain accounts] [--dry-run]

A repeat run over unchanged inputs writes nothing. To extend the input set, add the file under the pinned input dir, add its line to `INPUTS.sha256` (`<sha256>  <path>`, sorted by path), and run the harvester; it refuses any file the manifest does not list or whose digest differs.
